source_refs.note: Topic 14.15.1, printed page 318. 'Natural Environmental Quality Standard' in print is given as National.

blocks.text: Common rules and regulations to control air pollution in Pakistan are the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act (PEPA 1997), the National Environmental Quality Standards (NEQS; printed 'Natural'), and the Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012.

blocks.prompt: Identify the laws and regulations related to air quality in Pakistan.
blocks.explanation: The Pakistan Environmental Protection Act of 1997, the National Environmental Quality Standards that set permitted emission and air-quality limits under it, and the Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act of 2012 that applies and strengthens them in Punjab.

items: PEPA 1997; NEQS; Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012.
